# E0348: a _coalesce reads a field the source version always has

coalesce supplies a fallback for a field that may be absent. Over a field the
source always has, the fallback could never apply; write the reference alone.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		b: _coalesce(v0_0.a, "x")
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0348]: 0.0 always has a, so _coalesce's fallback could never apply: write b: v0_0.a
 --> history/1.0.thema:8:6
  |
8 |         b: _coalesce(v0_0.a, "x")
  |            ^^^^^^^^^
  |
```
